name: Launchtory

sources.title: Launchtory homepage — niche project directory with Featured/New/Recently submitted sections (Ahrefs DR 56)
Pricing — $19 one-time Featured publishing for approved projects; free self-serve options mentioned

conditions: All submissions must pass a safety and quality review before anything (free or paid) is published
Free publishing happens 'through free self-serve options, including community votes or website link verification, when available from the project status page' — availability is not guaranteed
requirements: Niche website/project with a real domain (listings key off the site's domain and stack)
Rejected content: adult, gambling, phishing, scams, malware, illegal activity, and harmful/misleading sites
Account required (Login/Signup in nav; submit at /projects/new)
preparation: Project name, domain/URL, description, topic tags, and tech stack (Stacks is a first-class browse facet: Next.js, Cloudflare, WordPress, etc.)
Optional $19 for Featured placement (one year) — 'does not guarantee traffic, clicks, rankings, leads, or sales'
workflow: Go to /projects/new and submit the project
Publish free via community votes or link verification (from the project status page when available), or pay $19 for Featured placement (one year)
watchFor: Free publish options are 'when available' — the guaranteed path is review + $19
Featured placement lasts one year, not permanent
Directory mixes topics and stacks — accurate stack tagging affects discoverability
countsAsLive: Project appears in 'Recently submitted'/'Latest projects' or its topic/stack page on launchtory.com with a details link
unknowns: Exact free-verification mechanics (what 'community votes' or 'link verification' concretely require)
